params.prompt:
Single continuous shot, locked-off tripod camera: no camera movement, no zoom, no cuts.

Lume, the furry mascot seated at the podcast table, speaks one Hebrew sentence to his co-host off-screen to the right, angrily. His speech is exactly the reference audio and his lips are synced to it: he starts speaking at 0.6 seconds and finishes at 2.1 seconds, saying: "אני רוצה לדבר עם האריה הזה".

Performance: angry and fuming. He scowls with lowered eyebrows and jabs one paw toward the table off-screen to the right on the last two words; the paw stays low, below his chin. After the last word he shuts his mouth and glares. Head and paw movement stay small and restrained; the face does the acting.

He stays exactly on-model as in the first frame: same fur, ears, eyes, eyebrows, nose, whiskers, hair tuft and tail. His mouth has exactly two teeth, the two small upper front teeth; his lower jaw is smooth and toothless, showing only the dark inside of the mouth and the pink tongue. His paws are plain fur with no paw pads. The microphone, chair, table, shelves, plants and lighting stay completely still and unchanged.

Audio: only his voice from the reference audio. No music, no sound effects, no other voices.
